candidates.explanation: The link for the change-email verification mail is built with the '/confirm-email' frontend path, the same as the sign-up activation mail (MailService.userSignUp). The frontend page at /confirm-email calls the sign-up endpoint POST auth/email/confirm (AuthService.confirmEmail). That endpoint expects a different JWT payload, because the new-email token carries newEmail. The email change therefore never reaches POST auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail). The path should be '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, build the URL with the '/confirm-new-email' path instead of '/confirm-email', so the link goes to the frontend page that calls auth/email/confirm/new.
